# MongoDB Mongosync - (current)

> Mongosync is a cluster-to-cluster synchronization utility for migrating data between self-managed MongoDB deployments and MongoDB Atlas.

- [About ``mongosync``](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongosync/current/about-mongosync.md)
- [Connecting ``mongosync``](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongosync/current/connecting.md)

- [Connect Two Self-Managed Clusters](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongosync/current/connecting/onprem-to-onprem.md)
